response.original_title: ((Guest!Guide)) How do I add a guest on a Princess Cruise?
response.overview: To add an extra guest, cabin, or guest to an existing Princess Cruise booking, you must call Princess Customer Service directly at ☎ +1-866-259-1002 (US) or  +44-120-420-8151 (UK) your regional support number) or contact your travel agent. To add a guest to your Princess Cruise booking, contact Princess Cruises at ☎ +1-866-259-1002 (US) or  +44-120-420-8151 (UK) to check cabin availability and request an additional guest.
